#### Description
packet_action enumeration missing `ACCEPT`, which is used in ACL control plane.
sonic-acl.yang
```
container sonic-acl {
                container ACL_RULE {
                        description "ACL_RULE part of config_db.json";
                        list ACL_RULE_LIST {
                                leaf PACKET_ACTION {
                                        type stypes:packet_action;
                                }
```
sonic-types.yang
```
typedef packet_action{
        type enumeration {
            enum DROP;
            enum FORWARD;
            enum REDIRECT;
            enum DO_NOT_NAT;
        }
    }

```
